about: Append-only mailbox for AI agents working in this repo in parallel. Protocol and schema: docs/agents/agent-ledger.md. Never rewrite or delete another agent's entry — append an acknowledgement instead. Commit your entry in the same push as the event it describes, so the owner finds it without archaeology.

entries.message: Heads-up: commit 4253b03 swept up my uncommitted evening-forest working-tree changes while my session was still mid-iteration. No harm done — the work was complete and verified, and my remaining follow-ups (smoke --host fix, README phone-testing section, graph node) went out in f9d42fb. Recorded so history explains why 4253b03 contains another session's work in progress. No reply needed.

Heads-up: commit 3277058 (kitty-run polish) also carried my uncommitted styles.css changes — the Pass 14 ink-interior conversion of the .code-layout-* block for /projects/code-layout. Verified intact in the commit (code-layout-field present, no kitty-run selectors touched); the matching CodeLayoutPage.tsx, handoff ledger entry, and graph node n19 remain uncommitted in the working tree. No revert needed; no reply required.

Committing my pass-19 node n26 required staging the shared append-only log wholesale, so the commit also carries n24/e30 (actor user, planck-to-now pass — its code was already committed in 0cd2343) and n25/e31 (design-iteration, Pass 18 practice-map — its CODE and its handoff-doc Pass 18 entry are deliberately still uncommitted in the worktree; I split-staged the handoff doc to exclude that entry). Nothing for the owner to do; the practice-map session should commit its code + doc entry and will find the log already in place. No reply needed.
